name: MCP hosting
summary: A path on mcp.abclegacyllc.com for a project's MCP server: TLS, routing, the public index, 410 on retirement, and rate limiting in two dimensions — per project and per caller — so one tenant cannot take the machine and one caller cannot take a tenant. When a tool ever needs identity, OAuth lands here too; the project implements neither.

options.upstream: optional — https://host:port when the server runs somewhere other than this machine (a graduated project keeps its endpoint this way)

limits.setBy: Labs, in registry.json: { "id": "…", "repo": "…", "mcp": { "tier": "default | heavy | internal" } }. A project may ask in its manifest; it cannot grant itself a tier.

tiers.default: 60 requests/min per caller, 600 per project; 4 and 20 concurrent
tiers.heavy: 120 requests/min per caller, 3000 per project; 8 and 60 concurrent
tiers.internal: no limit — for Labs's own services
